problem.title: A finished video touches five different tools
problem.description: The script lives in one app, the thumbnail in another, the sound effects come from a stock site, the images from somewhere else — and the style quietly drifts apart between all of them.
problem.note: Moving files between them is the part that eats the evening.

items.title: Thumbnails
items.description: Generate on-brand cover images from your script — one style per project, so every thumbnail looks like the same channel.

items.title: Scripts
items.description: Draft the hook, the outline and the full script with the structure of your niche built in. Edit anything by hand; the draft is a starting point, not a locked output.

items.title: Sound Effects
items.description: Describe the mood — "tense build to a punchline" — and get sound effects and music beds that fit the cut instead of hunting stock libraries.

items.title: Images
items.description: Scene stills and supporting visuals that match the thumbnails, stored next to the project they belong to.
